原生音视频多模态

introduction.zh: Gemini 是 Google DeepMind 的多模态模型家族，围绕文本、图像、音频、视频、代码和搜索增强构建。它既出现在 Gemini 消费产品中，也通过 Gemini API 与 Vertex AI 面向开发者和企业。
introduction.en: Gemini is Google DeepMind's multimodal model family spanning text, image, audio, video, code and search grounding. It appears in the Gemini consumer product and through Gemini API and Vertex AI.

introduction.zh: 系列名称下包含 Pro、Flash 等不同定位以及多个代际。评估时要区分具体版本、上下文窗口、思考能力、区域可用性和云平台计费。
introduction.en: The family contains Pro, Flash and other tiers across generations. Evaluation must distinguish the exact release, context, thinking behavior, regional availability and cloud pricing.

significance.zh: Gemini 的核心价值是把原生多模态、长上下文、搜索与 Google 云生态结合，适合需要处理复杂媒体或大量上下文的产品。
significance.en: Gemini's core value is the combination of native multimodality, long context, search and Google Cloud, especially for media-rich or context-heavy products.

description.zh: 重点不只是识图，而是统一处理文本、图像、音频、视频和代码。
description.en: The focus goes beyond image understanding to unified text, image, audio, video and code.

description.zh: 可用于长视频、代码库和多文档分析，但长上下文仍不等于可靠召回。
description.en: Useful for long video, codebases and document sets, though long context does not guarantee reliable recall.

description.zh: Gemini 应用、API 与 Vertex AI 的功能、配额和数据治理选项并不完全相同。
description.en: Gemini app, API and Vertex AI differ in features, quotas and data-governance options.

description.zh: 用于视频摘要、片段定位与跨模态问答，并需抽样核对时间点和事实。
description.en: For video summary, moment retrieval and cross-modal Q&A, with sampled fact checking.

description.zh: 用于长文档、代码仓库和会议资料综合，适合先检索再精读的流程。
description.en: For documents, repositories and meeting corpora, ideally with retrieve-then-read workflows.

description.zh: 适合已经使用 Vertex AI、搜索和 Google 数据平台的企业系统。
description.en: Useful for enterprise systems already using Vertex AI, search and Google data services.

limitations.zh: 不同区域、产品入口和模型档位的可用性与限制可能不同。
limitations.en: Availability and limits vary by region, product surface and model tier.

limitations.zh: 多模态回答仍可能误读图表、视频时序或细小视觉信息。
limitations.en: Multimodal answers can still misread charts, temporal video details or small visual elements.

limitations.zh: 价格、配额与可用性以具体型号和接入渠道的官方资料为准；尚未核实的条件保持未知。
limitations.en: Verify prices, quotas and availability for the exact model and access channel; unverified conditions remain unknown.

introduction.zh: OpenAI 是一家同时从事人工智能研究、模型训练和产品部署的机构。对普通用户而言，它最具代表性的产品是 ChatGPT；对开发者和企业而言，GPT 模型与 API 构成了文本生成、代码、多模态理解和 Agent 应用的基础能力。
introduction.en: OpenAI combines AI research, model training and product deployment. ChatGPT is its best-known consumer product, while GPT models and APIs provide foundational capabilities for text, code, multimodality and agents.

introduction.zh: 在 AI Radar 中，OpenAI 不是一个孤立的公司名称，而是 GPT 系列、具体模型版本、评测成绩、价格变化和下游应用的研发方节点。查看该节点的意义，是理解某次模型更新由谁发布、影响哪些产品，以及相关事实来自哪里。
introduction.en: In AI Radar, OpenAI connects the GPT family, concrete releases, benchmark results, pricing changes and downstream applications. The node explains who released an update, what it affects and which evidence supports it.

significance.zh: OpenAI 把前沿模型能力同时带入大众产品和开发者平台，推动了生成式 AI 从研究成果转变为可直接使用的通用工具。追踪 OpenAI，通常意味着同时追踪模型能力、API 生态、产品形态和治理结构的变化。
significance.en: OpenAI helped move frontier models from research into mass-market products and developer infrastructure. Tracking it means following capabilities, APIs, products and governance together.

introduction.zh: Anthropic 是一家人工智能安全与研究公司，目标是构建可靠、可解释且可控的 AI 系统。它把安全研究落实到 Claude 模型、API 和企业产品中，并持续发布有关对齐、可解释性、治理和社会影响的研究。
introduction.en: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company building reliable, interpretable and steerable systems. It applies that research through Claude, APIs and enterprise products while publishing work on alignment, interpretability, governance and societal impact.

introduction.zh: 在知识图谱中，Anthropic 连接 Claude 各版本与 Model Context Protocol。它既是模型研发方，也是影响 Agent 工具连接方式的重要协议推动者，因此需要同时从模型、协议和安全治理三个层面理解。
introduction.en: In the graph, Anthropic connects Claude releases and the Model Context Protocol. It should be understood across models, protocols and safety governance.

significance.zh: Anthropic 的差异不只是“另一个大模型公司”，而是把安全、可解释性和可控性作为产品研发的核心约束。Claude 与 MCP 也使它对长文本、代码 Agent 和工具生态产生了直接影响。
significance.en: Anthropic differentiates itself by treating safety, interpretability and steerability as product constraints. Claude and MCP also shape long-context, coding-agent and tool ecosystems.

summary.zh: 选择具体模型或产品后再确认 API、应用、开发组件与自部署入口。
summary.en: Choose a specific model or product before confirming APIs, apps, development components and self-hosting.

items.zh: 理解不同 Claude 版本在长上下文、代码、Agent 和安全策略上的变化。
items.en: Follow changes in context, coding, agents and safety behavior across Claude releases.

items.zh: 连接模型能力与对齐、可解释性、治理政策等研究方向。
items.en: Connect model capabilities with alignment, interpretability and governance research.

items.zh: 追踪 Anthropic 如何通过开放协议连接模型、数据源和工具。
items.en: Track how Anthropic uses an open protocol to connect models, data and tools.

summary.zh: 评估 Anthropic 时，把组织背景与具体服务承诺分开；右侧目录来自已收录的直接关系。
summary.en: When evaluating Anthropic, separate organizational background from specific service commitments; the related catalog uses recorded direct relationships.

items.zh: 安全与能力指标应区分官方系统卡、独立评测和真实生产表现。
items.en: Separate official system cards, independent evaluations and real production behavior.

items.zh: 公司理念不能直接替代对具体模型版本和部署风险的评估。
items.en: Company principles do not replace evaluation of concrete releases and deployment risks.

items.zh: 采购或集成时核对具体服务的区域、账户、费用、数据处理与支持条件。
items.en: For purchasing or integration, check the exact service's regions, accounts, costs, data handling and support terms.

summary.zh: 用于构建 LLM 应用和 Agent 的开源框架，提供模型与工具集成、预构建 Agent 架构、检索增强和中间件能力。
summary.en: Open-source framework for LLM applications and agents, with model/tool integrations, prebuilt agent architecture, retrieval and middleware.

capabilities.zh: 多模型与工具集成
预构建 Agent 架构
检索增强生成

introduction.zh: LangChain 是一个面向大语言模型应用的开源开发框架。它解决的核心问题不是训练模型，而是把模型与提示、工具、数据源、检索系统和业务流程连接起来，让开发者能较快搭建问答、RAG 和 Agent 应用。
introduction.en: LangChain is an open-source framework for applications powered by language models. It does not train models; it connects models with prompts, tools, data, retrieval and business workflows.

introduction.zh: 当前 LangChain 的高层 Agent API 构建在 LangGraph 运行时之上：LangChain 适合快速开始，LangGraph 更适合需要持久执行、人工介入、精细状态控制和复杂工作流的场景。
introduction.en: Its high-level agents run on LangGraph: LangChain favors fast starts, while LangGraph serves durable execution, human-in-the-loop control and complex workflows.

significance.zh: LangChain 把快速变化的模型与工具接口抽象成相对统一的应用层，使团队更容易替换模型、增加检索或接入工具。它的价值主要在应用编排和生态集成，而不在模型本身。
significance.en: LangChain provides a common application layer over rapidly changing model and tool APIs. Its value is orchestration and integration rather than model capability.

description.zh: 快速构建 Agent、RAG、工具调用与多模型应用。
description.en: Quickly building agents, RAG, tool use and multi-model applications.

description.zh: Agent 在模型与工具之间循环执行，直到产生最终结果或达到停止条件。
description.en: Agents loop between models and tools until a final result or stop condition.

description.zh: LangChain Agent 建立在 LangGraph 之上，高级需求可下沉到更低层运行时。
description.en: LangChain agents use LangGraph underneath, with advanced workflows able to use the lower-level runtime.

description.zh: 连接文档加载器、向量库和检索器，构建有来源的 RAG 问答。
description.en: Combine loaders, vector stores and retrievers for grounded RAG.

description.zh: 让模型根据任务调用搜索、数据库、代码执行或业务 API。
description.en: Let models invoke search, databases, code execution or business APIs.

description.zh: 用统一接口接入不同模型，并在应用层保留编排逻辑。
description.en: Connect multiple providers behind shared application orchestration.

limitations.zh: 抽象层能提高开发速度，但复杂生产系统仍需自行处理评估、监控、权限、成本和失败恢复。
limitations.en: Abstractions speed development, but production systems still need evaluation, observability, permissions, cost control and recovery.

limitations.zh: 简单的一次模型调用通常不需要引入完整框架。
limitations.en: A simple one-shot model call often does not require a full framework.

summary.zh: 通过模型、工具和预置 Agent 抽象构建 LLM 应用。
summary.en: Build LLM applications with model, tool and prebuilt agent abstractions.

items.zh: 选择模型接口，定义工具输入输出，再构建最小任务流程。
items.en: Select a model interface, define tool inputs and outputs and build a minimal workflow.

items.zh: RAG 需要另外准备索引、检索评估与引用检查。
items.en: RAG additionally requires indexing, retrieval evaluation and citation checks.

summary.zh: 应用框架与底层状态编排解决不同问题，不能把包安装成功当作可用系统。
summary.en: Application abstractions and lower-level state orchestration solve different problems.

items.zh: 明确工具失败、重试、会话状态和追踪策略。
items.en: Define tool failure, retries, session state and tracing policies.

items.zh: 需要精细控制状态时进一步核对 LangGraph。
items.en: Evaluate LangGraph when finer state control is required.

summary.zh: 从真实任务和工具调用结果检查应用质量。
summary.en: Validate application quality against real tasks and tool results.

items.zh: 单独测试模型响应与工具副作用，并记录失败轨迹。
items.en: Test model responses and tool effects separately and record failure traces.

items.zh: 框架不提供业务正确性保证，模型和运行服务费用分别计。
items.en: The framework does not guarantee business correctness; model and runtime costs remain separate.

summary.zh: 以真实开源仓库 GitHub Issue 为任务、通过运行测试验证补丁的代码 Agent 评测；Verified 子集包含 500 个经工程师确认可解决的实例。
summary.en: Coding-agent benchmark built from real GitHub issues and test-validated patches; its Verified subset contains 500 engineer-confirmed solvable instances.

capabilities.zh: 真实 GitHub Issue
测试驱动的补丁验证
500 个工程师核验实例

introduction.zh: SWE-bench 用真实 GitHub 仓库中的 Issue 和对应修复来评估模型的软件工程能力。模型不仅要写一段看起来合理的代码，还要理解仓库、定位问题、生成可应用的补丁，并通过该项目的测试套件。
introduction.en: SWE-bench evaluates software-engineering ability using real GitHub issues and their fixes. A model must understand a repository, locate the problem, produce an applicable patch and pass the project's tests.

introduction.zh: SWE-bench Verified 是其中更常用于模型对比的子集，包含 500 个由软件工程师确认可解决的问题。它比单函数代码题更接近真实开发，但最终分数也会受到 Agent 脚手架、工具、上下文策略和尝试次数影响。
introduction.en: SWE-bench Verified contains 500 tasks confirmed solvable by software engineers. It is more realistic than isolated coding questions, but scores also depend on agent scaffolding, tools, context strategy and attempts.

significance.zh: 它把“会生成代码”推进到“能否完成真实仓库修复”，因此常被用来判断代码模型和代码 Agent 的端到端工程能力。
significance.en: It shifts evaluation from generating code snippets to completing real repository fixes, making it useful for end-to-end coding-agent assessment.

description.zh: 真实开源仓库中的 GitHub Issue 及其对应修复。
description.en: Real GitHub issues and corresponding fixes from open-source repositories.

description.zh: 在隔离环境中应用模型补丁并运行仓库测试，通过测试才算解决。
description.en: Apply the generated patch in an isolated environment and run repository tests.

description.zh: 500 个由工程师确认可解决的实例。
description.en: 500 instances verified by engineers as solvable.

description.zh: 比较不同模型与 Agent 系统在真实缺陷修复上的成功率。
description.en: Compare models and agents on real defect-resolution success.

description.zh: 评估搜索、编辑、测试和上下文管理策略是否真正提升完成率。
description.en: Evaluate whether search, editing, testing and context strategies improve completion.

description.zh: 在相近评测设置下观察同一模型系列的版本迭代。
description.en: Track version changes under comparable evaluation settings.

limitations.zh: 分数并非纯模型能力：Agent 脚手架、工具权限、采样次数和测试环境都会影响结果。
limitations.en: Scores are not pure model ability; scaffolding, permissions, attempts and environment matter.

limitations.zh: 排行榜结果只有在评测版本和运行设置一致时才适合横向比较。
limitations.en: Leaderboard results are comparable only when benchmark versions and run settings align.

summary.zh: SWE-bench 以真实开源仓库中的 issue 为问题，检查代码补丁。
summary.en: SWE-bench uses issues from real open-source repositories to evaluate code patches.

items.zh: 固定仓库状态、issue 描述和测试环境，再运行解题系统。
items.en: Fix repository state, issue description and test environment before running the system.

items.zh: Verified 是经过人工筛选的 500 个实例，不能与其他子集直接混报。
items.en: Verified contains 500 human-screened instances; keep subset results separate.

summary.zh: 分数反映特定系统、工具和预算下的测试通过情况。
summary.en: Scores reflect test outcomes under a particular system, tools and budget.

items.zh: 记录模型版本、Agent scaffold、运行次数和任务预算。
items.en: Record model version, agent scaffold, repetitions and task budget.

items.zh: 核对提交补丁与失败测试，不把基准排名当作所有工程任务效果。
items.en: Inspect patches and failing tests; benchmark rank does not generalize to every task.

summary.zh: 用于软件修复能力比较，仍需业务仓库试点。
summary.en: Useful for repair comparisons, with trials on your own repositories still required.

items.zh: 使用相同子集和执行环境，注明不同设置。
items.en: Use the same subset and environment and disclose differing settings.

items.zh: 测试通过不代表安全、性能或可维护性全部达标。
items.en: Passing tests does not establish safety, performance or maintainability.

summary.zh: 面向专业知识与多步推理的高难度多学科选择题评测；通过更难题目和十选一设置增强区分度与提示稳定性。
summary.en: Challenging multi-domain benchmark for expert knowledge and reasoning, using harder questions and ten choices for stronger discrimination and prompt stability.

capabilities.zh: 专业级多学科问题
十选一降低随机猜测
对提示变化更稳定

introduction.zh: MMLU-Pro 是在经典 MMLU 基础上设计的更困难、更稳健的多任务语言理解评测。它增加需要推理的专业级问题，把每题选项从四个扩展为十个，并清理部分简单或噪声较高的问题。
introduction.en: MMLU-Pro is a harder, more robust successor to MMLU. It adds reasoning-heavy professional questions, expands choices from four to ten and removes some trivial or noisy items.

introduction.zh: 它主要测试模型跨学科知识和推理的综合表现，适合观察模型在数学、物理、法律、健康等领域的广度，但不能单独代表对话体验、事实可靠性、代码能力或真实业务效果。
introduction.en: It tests broad knowledge and reasoning across fields such as mathematics, physics, law and health, but does not by itself represent chat quality, factual reliability, coding or business outcomes.

significance.zh: 当传统 MMLU 对前沿模型的区分度下降时，MMLU-Pro 用更难问题和更多选项重新拉开差距，并降低不同提示措辞造成的分数波动。
significance.en: As frontier models saturated MMLU, MMLU-Pro restored separation with harder questions and more choices while reducing prompt sensitivity.

description.zh: 论文报告相较 MMLU，模型准确率普遍下降 16%–33%。
description.en: The paper reports accuracy drops of 16–33% compared with MMLU.

description.zh: 每题从四选一扩展到十选一，降低随机猜中的概率。
description.en: Questions expand from four to ten choices, reducing random-guess success.

description.zh: 论文测试 24 种提示风格，分数波动低于原始 MMLU。
description.en: Across 24 prompt styles, scores varied less than on original MMLU.

description.zh: 快速观察模型跨领域知识与推理是否存在明显短板。
description.en: Screen for broad knowledge and reasoning weaknesses.

description.zh: 在相同提示和评测实现下比较同系列版本。
description.en: Compare versions under the same prompt and evaluation implementation.

description.zh: 和代码、数学、安全、事实性等专项评测结合形成完整画像。
description.en: Combine with coding, math, safety and factuality evaluations.

limitations.zh: 选择题成绩可能受提示模板、答案解析方式和数据污染影响。
limitations.en: Multiple-choice scores can be affected by prompts, answer parsing and contamination.

limitations.zh: 高分不等于在开放式任务、真实工作流或特定语言环境中表现同样优秀。
limitations.en: A high score does not guarantee open-ended, workflow or multilingual performance.

summary.zh: MMLU-Pro 用更难的多学科题目和更多选项增强推理区分度。
summary.en: MMLU-Pro uses harder multidisciplinary questions and more options to distinguish reasoning.

items.zh: 任务仍是选择题知识与推理评测，不能当作工具执行评测。
items.en: It remains a knowledge and reasoning multiple-choice evaluation, not tool execution.

items.zh: 论文描述过滤与十选一设置，比较时保留同一题目集。
items.en: The paper describes filtering and ten-option questions; keep the question set fixed.

summary.zh: 模型成绩需要结合提示、采样和评分设置解释。
summary.en: Interpret scores with prompting, sampling and grading settings.

items.zh: 分别报告总体与学科结果，标出模型和评测版本。
items.en: Report overall and subject results with model and evaluation versions.

items.zh: 原论文发现相对 MMLU 的准确率下降；这是当时的实验结果。
items.en: The paper reports lower accuracy than MMLU; this is a historical experimental result.

summary.zh: 适合观察多学科推理差异，不能替代真实任务验收。
summary.en: Useful for multidisciplinary reasoning comparisons, not business acceptance.

items.zh: 检查训练污染、题目覆盖和统计误差。
items.en: Check contamination, question coverage and statistical uncertainty.

items.zh: 与代码、工具或多模态评测分开解释。
items.en: Interpret it separately from coding, tool and multimodal benchmarks.

summary.zh: 2017 年提出 Transformer 的论文，以自注意力取代循环和卷积作为序列建模核心，成为现代大语言模型的重要架构基础。
summary.en: The 2017 paper introducing the Transformer, replacing recurrence and convolution with attention as the core of sequence modeling.

capabilities.zh: 纯注意力序列建模
高度并行训练
编码器—解码器架构

introduction.zh: 《Attention Is All You Need》由 Ashish Vaswani 等八位作者在 2017 年发表。论文提出 Transformer：不再依赖循环神经网络逐词处理序列，而是用自注意力计算序列中不同位置之间的关联。
introduction.en: Published in 2017 by Ashish Vaswani and seven coauthors, Attention Is All You Need introduced the Transformer, replacing recurrent sequence processing with self-attention across positions.

introduction.zh: 原论文面向机器翻译，采用编码器—解码器结构，并结合多头注意力、前馈网络、残差连接和位置编码。后来的 BERT、GPT 和大量多模态模型并非原样复制，而是选择其编码器、解码器或其他变体并大规模扩展。
introduction.en: The original machine-translation model used an encoder-decoder with multi-head attention, feed-forward networks, residual connections and positional encoding. Later systems such as BERT and GPT adapted and scaled selected parts.

significance.zh: Transformer 允许序列位置并行计算，显著提高训练效率和扩展能力，为后续扩大模型参数、数据量和上下文长度提供了可行架构。
significance.en: Parallel computation across sequence positions improved training efficiency and scalability, enabling later growth in parameters, data and context.

description.zh: 以注意力机制为核心，移除循环和卷积序列层。
description.en: Use attention as the core mechanism without recurrent or convolutional sequence layers.

description.zh: 首先在英德和英法机器翻译任务上验证。
description.en: Initially evaluated on English–German and English–French translation.

description.zh: 相较循环网络更容易并行训练，训练时间显著降低。
description.en: More parallelizable than recurrent networks, with substantially lower training time.

description.zh: 解释 GPT、BERT、Claude 等模型为何在图谱中与 Transformer 相连。
description.en: Explain why families such as GPT, BERT and Claude trace back to Transformers.

description.zh: 理解自注意力、多头注意力、位置编码与编码器—解码器。
description.en: Study self-attention, multi-head attention, positional encoding and encoder-decoder design.

description.zh: 判断后续模型保留、删除或改造了原架构的哪些部分。
description.en: Identify which original components later models retain, remove or modify.

limitations.zh: 原论文结论来自机器翻译实验，不能直接等同于今天所有大语言模型的能力结论。
limitations.en: The original evidence came from translation and does not directly establish modern LLM capabilities.

limitations.zh: 标准注意力的计算与内存成本随序列长度快速增长，长上下文模型通常需要额外优化。
limitations.en: Standard attention becomes expensive with sequence length, so long-context models require further optimization.

summary.zh: 2017 年提出 Transformer，以注意力构造序列转换架构。
summary.en: The 2017 paper introduces the Transformer for sequence transduction using attention.

items.zh: 编码器和解码器通过多头注意力、前馈层及位置编码处理序列。
items.en: Encoders and decoders combine multi-head attention, feed-forward layers and positional encoding.

items.zh: 原实验聚焦机器翻译，与今日完整 Agent 产品相隔多个技术层次。
items.en: Original experiments focus on translation, several layers removed from modern agent products.

summary.zh: 先理解输入表示与注意力，再看架构和实验设置。
summary.en: Start with representations and attention, then study architecture and experiments.

items.zh: 结合公式查看 query、key、value 与缩放点积注意力。
items.en: Relate the equations to queries, keys, values and scaled dot-product attention.

items.zh: 比较训练配置、翻译数据集和消融，不只记模型名称。
items.en: Compare training, translation datasets and ablations, not just the architecture name.

summary.zh: 论文是架构基础资料，其结果属于当时的训练与评测条件。
summary.en: It is a foundational architecture reference whose results belong to its original setup.

items.zh: 复现时区分原论文设定与后续 decoder-only 等变体。
items.en: Distinguish the original setup from later decoder-only and other variants.

items.zh: 不能据此推断某个现代模型的价格、可靠性或工具能力。
items.en: It cannot establish a modern model's cost, reliability or tool capability.

summary.zh: 连接 AI 应用与外部数据、工具和工作流的开放协议，通过 Host—Client—Server 架构统一上下文交换与能力调用。
summary.en: Open protocol connecting AI applications with external data, tools and workflows through a host-client-server architecture.

capabilities.zh: Tools 工具调用
Resources 上下文资源
Prompts 提示模板

introduction.zh: Model Context Protocol（MCP）是一套开放协议，用来标准化 AI 应用与外部系统之间的连接。过去每个模型应用都要为数据库、文件系统、开发工具或 SaaS 服务分别编写集成；MCP 把这些连接抽象成共同的协议和 SDK。
introduction.en: Model Context Protocol is an open standard for connecting AI applications with external systems. Instead of bespoke integrations for databases, files, developer tools or SaaS products, MCP provides a shared protocol and SDKs.

introduction.zh: MCP 采用 Host—Client—Server 架构：Host 是 Claude Desktop、IDE 或其他 AI 应用；Host 为每个 Server 创建 Client；Server 暴露 tools、resources 和 prompts。它规定的是通信与能力发现方式，不规定底层模型，也不会自动替代权限和安全控制。
introduction.en: MCP uses a host-client-server architecture. A host creates a client for each server, while servers expose tools, resources and prompts. It standardizes communication and discovery, not the underlying model or security policy.

significance.zh: MCP 的价值类似 AI 工具生态中的通用连接层：工具提供方实现一次 Server，多个兼容 Host 即可接入；AI 应用也不必为每个服务维护完全不同的适配代码。
significance.en: MCP acts as a common connectivity layer: a provider can implement one server for multiple compatible hosts, while AI apps avoid maintaining wholly separate integrations.

description.zh: 用户实际操作的 AI 应用，负责权限、生命周期和用户体验。
description.en: The AI application users operate, responsible for permissions, lifecycle and UX.

description.zh: Host 内与单个 MCP Server 保持会话和通信的协议组件。
description.en: The protocol component maintaining a session with one MCP server.

description.zh: 向 AI 应用提供工具、资源或提示模板的程序。
description.en: A program exposing tools, resources or prompt templates to an AI application.

description.zh: 让 AI 应用按权限读取知识库、文件、数据库或业务系统。
description.en: Provide permissioned access to knowledge bases, files, databases and business systems.

description.zh: 把搜索、代码执行、工单、监控或设计工具暴露给 Agent。
description.en: Expose search, code execution, tickets, monitoring or design tools to agents.

description.zh: 同一个 MCP Server 可被多个兼容客户端复用。
description.en: Reuse one MCP server across multiple compatible clients.

limitations.zh: 协议兼容不等于安全；Host 仍需限制工具权限、敏感数据、网络范围和用户确认流程。
limitations.en: Protocol compatibility is not security; hosts must still govern tools, data, network access and confirmation.

limitations.zh: 不同客户端与 Server 对规范版本、传输方式和扩展能力的支持可能不一致。
limitations.en: Clients and servers may differ in specification versions, transports and extensions.

summary.zh: MCP 是应用连接数据、工具和提示资源的协议，不是 Agent 框架。
summary.en: MCP is a protocol connecting applications to tools, data and prompt resources, not an agent framework.

items.zh: Host 管理用户体验与权限；Client 维持与 Server 的连接。
items.en: The host manages user experience and permissions; clients maintain server connections.

items.zh: Server 暴露支持的能力，接入方需要理解其数据与操作范围。
items.en: Servers expose capabilities; clients must understand their data and operation scope.

summary.zh: 按协议协商能力，再发现和调用相应资源。
summary.en: Negotiate capabilities, then discover and call supported resources.

items.zh: 核对连接方式、身份验证和工具参数定义。
items.en: Check transport, authentication and tool schemas.

items.zh: 为外部工具设置超时、错误处理和操作审批。
items.en: Set timeouts, error handling and approvals for external tools.

summary.zh: 协议兼容不意味着 Server 内容和操作可信。
summary.en: Protocol compatibility does not establish trust in server content or actions.

items.zh: 为不同 Server 限制最小数据与操作范围。
items.en: Limit each server to the data and actions it needs.

items.zh: 将工具返回内容视为资料，避免让外部内容修改授权范围。
items.en: Treat tool responses as data and keep authorization independent of external content.

summary.zh: 面向软件开发的 AI 代码编辑器，把代码库检索、问答、补全、多文件编辑、终端命令与自主 Agent 集成在同一工作环境中。
summary.en: AI code editor combining codebase search, Q&A, completion, multi-file editing, terminal commands and autonomous agents.

capabilities.zh: 代码库语义检索
多文件 Agent 编辑
终端执行与差异审查

introduction.zh: Cursor 是面向软件开发的 AI 代码编辑器。它把传统编辑器能力与模型对话、代码库检索、补全、内联修改和 Agent 模式结合，使 AI 可以在理解项目上下文后跨文件修改代码、运行命令并根据结果继续迭代。
introduction.en: Cursor is an AI code editor combining traditional editing with model chat, codebase retrieval, completion, inline edits and agents that can modify files, run commands and iterate on results.

introduction.zh: Cursor 的 Agent 适合完成复杂功能和重构；Ask 模式偏向只读理解；精确编辑模式适合控制修改范围。它本身不是一个基础模型，而是把不同模型、上下文检索和开发工具组织成完整工作流的应用层产品。
introduction.en: Agent handles complex features and refactors, while Ask favors read-only understanding and targeted modes limit edits. Cursor is an application layer combining models, retrieval and developer tools, not a foundation model.

significance.zh: Cursor 代表 AI 编程从“给出代码建议”走向“理解仓库并执行多步骤任务”。评价它不能只看底层模型，还要看检索、编辑、终端工具、差异审查和用户控制是否形成可靠闭环。
significance.en: Cursor represents the shift from code suggestions to repository-aware multi-step execution. Its value depends on retrieval, editing, terminal tools, diff review and user control—not only the underlying model.

description.zh: 可自主搜索代码库、编辑多个文件、运行终端命令并完成复杂任务。
description.en: Autonomously searches a codebase, edits files, runs terminal commands and completes complex tasks.

description.zh: 只读搜索和解释代码，适合理解项目后再决定是否修改。
description.en: Read-only search and explanation for understanding a project before editing.

description.zh: 以增删行差异检查 AI 修改，允许开发者在接受前保持控制。
description.en: Review additions and deletions before accepting AI-generated changes.

description.zh: 通过语义搜索和问答定位架构、调用链与关键文件。
description.en: Use semantic search and Q&A to locate architecture, call paths and key files.

description.zh: 让 Agent 修改实现、测试和配置，并运行检查验证结果。
description.en: Let an agent update implementation, tests and config, then run checks.

description.zh: 结合代码检索、终端和差异审查完成可控迭代。
description.en: Combine retrieval, terminal tools and diff review for controlled iteration.

limitations.zh: Agent 可能产生范围过大的修改或错误假设，关键变更仍需要人工审查和测试。
limitations.en: Agents can make overly broad changes or incorrect assumptions; critical work still needs review and testing.

limitations.zh: 实际体验受所选模型、代码库规模、索引质量、上下文和工具权限影响。
limitations.en: Results depend on model choice, repository size, indexing quality, context and tool permissions.

summary.zh: 以项目为上下文，将代码理解、编辑和 Agent 执行放在开发环境内。
summary.en: Use project context for code understanding, editing and agent execution inside the development environment.

items.zh: 提供目标文件或项目规则，再检查生成的改动。
items.en: Provide target files or project rules and inspect changes.

items.zh: 在编辑器中运行验证，结合 Git 差异决定保留哪些修改。
items.en: Run validation and use Git diffs to decide which changes to keep.

summary.zh: 产品负责上下文和工具编排，底层模型选择与产品本身分开理解。
summary.en: The product manages context and tools; distinguish the model choice from the editor product.

items.zh: 检查当前模型、工具权限和项目索引范围。
items.en: Check the selected model, tool permissions and project indexing scope.

items.zh: MCP 等工具接入需要额外核对服务和数据范围。
items.en: Check service and data scope separately when adding tools such as MCP.

summary.en: Compare with TraeCode on IDE workflows and with terminal agents on task control.

introduction.en: Start with the specific product you intend to use, then review its documentation, access conditions and delivery limits.

description.zh: 核对权限、人工审批与审计要求。
description.en: Check permissions, human approvals and auditing requirements.

limitations.zh: 企业平台功能不能直接当作开源框架的默认能力。
limitations.en: Enterprise features are not automatically included in the open-source framework.

limitations.zh: 模型调用、工具权限和部署成本仍需单独评估。

items.en: The framework and enterprise platform are distinct adoption paths with separate capabilities and terms.

summary.en: Choose a specific model or product before confirming APIs, apps, development components and self-hosting.

items.zh: 从任务分工和流程控制判断框架是否适用。
items.en: Evaluate task delegation and workflow control.

items.zh: 区分自己开发运行与购买企业平台服务。
items.en: Compare self-managed development with enterprise platform adoption.

items.en: Check permissions, human approvals and auditing requirements.

summary.zh: 评估 CrewAI 时，把组织背景与具体服务承诺分开；右侧目录来自已收录的直接关系。
summary.en: When evaluating CrewAI, separate organizational background from specific service commitments; the related catalog uses recorded direct relationships.

items.zh: 采购或集成时核对具体服务的区域、账户、费用、数据处理与支持条件。
items.en: For purchasing or integration, check the exact service's regions, accounts, costs, data handling and support terms.

summary.zh: OpenAI 的编码 Agent，可在本地仓库中检查文件、修改代码并运行开发工具，也有 IDE 与云端入口。
summary.en: OpenAI's coding agent inspects files, edits code and runs local development tools, with IDE and cloud entry points.

capabilities.zh: 并行处理软件工程任务
代码库任务执行与测试
隔离执行环境

introduction.zh: OpenAI 的编码 Agent，可在本地仓库中检查文件、修改代码并运行开发工具，也有 IDE 与云端入口。
introduction.en: OpenAI's coding agent inspects files, edits code and runs local development tools, with IDE and cloud entry points.

introduction.zh: 它的价值应通过实际任务范围、权限、测试结果和人工审查来判断，而不是把模型名称当作交付保证。
introduction.en: Its value should be judged through task scope, permissions, test results and human review rather than model branding.

significance.zh: Codex 把编码模型能力包装为可执行、可审查的软件工程工作流。
significance.en: Codex packages coding-model capability into an executable, reviewable engineering workflow.

description.zh: Codex CLI 在终端读取仓库、修改文件和运行工具；模型、权限和执行命令可按任务配置。
description.en: Codex CLI reads repositories, edits files and runs tools from the terminal, with configurable models and permissions.

description.zh: 可同时处理多个相互独立的软件工程任务。
description.en: It can work on multiple independent engineering tasks in parallel.

description.zh: 输出应以变更和测试结果接受人工审查。
description.en: Outputs should be reviewed as changes with test results.

description.zh: 将边界清晰的功能任务交给 Agent 完成初稿与验证。
description.en: Delegate well-scoped features for a draft and validation.

description.zh: 用于定位、修改并运行测试验证修复。
description.en: Use it to investigate, change and test fixes.

description.zh: 辅助发现变更风险，但不能替代最终负责的评审者。
description.en: Assist with change-risk discovery without replacing accountable reviewers.

limitations.zh: 能力受仓库、权限、任务拆分和测试覆盖率影响。
limitations.en: Results depend on the repository, permissions, task decomposition and test coverage.

limitations.zh: 高风险变更仍必须由人类审查和批准。
limitations.en: High-risk changes still require human review and approval.

summary.zh: 通过代码上下文、文件编辑、工具执行和测试推进软件工程任务。
summary.en: Advances software tasks through code context, file edits, tool execution and tests.

items.zh: 给出需求、仓库约定与验证方式，查看实际修改。
items.en: Supply requirements, repository conventions and validation steps; inspect actual edits.

items.zh: 以可复现测试与差异验收结果，不只看回复。
items.en: Review reproducible tests and diffs rather than the response alone.

summary.zh: CLI 与云端任务的环境、权限和可用工具不同，不能混成一个运行位置。
summary.en: CLI and cloud tasks differ in environment, permissions and available tools.

items.zh: 本地任务在指定工作区执行，云端任务使用其配置环境。
items.en: Local tasks run in the selected workspace; cloud tasks use their configured environment.

items.zh: Codex 是软件任务产品；所用模型与产品入口分别记录。
items.en: Codex is a software-task product; model and interface are recorded separately.

summary.zh: 与 Claude Code、Cursor、TraeCode 共同按编程用途比较。
summary.en: Compare with Claude Code, Cursor and TraeCode under coding workflows.

items.zh: 检查仓库权限、终端执行、任务隔离、异步工作与审查方式。
items.en: Check repository access, commands, isolation, asynchronous work and review controls.

items.zh: 选择工具前在同一任务上测修改质量和人工审查成本。
items.en: Measure change quality and human review cost on the same task.

summary.zh: Anthropic 提供的终端编码 Agent，可阅读代码、编辑文件、运行测试并在用户监督下使用命令行工具。
summary.en: Anthropic's terminal coding agent that can read code, edit files, run tests and use command-line tools with user oversight.

capabilities.zh: 代码搜索与编辑
运行测试
命令行工具调用

introduction.zh: Claude Code 是 Anthropic 发布的命令行编码 Agent。
introduction.en: Claude Code is Anthropic's command-line coding agent.

introduction.zh: 它能在项目中搜索、编辑和运行测试，但仍应保持用户对变更和权限的控制。
introduction.en: It can search, edit and test projects, while users should retain control over changes and permissions.

significance.zh: Claude Code 代表模型能力通过终端和开发工作流进入工程现场。
significance.en: Claude Code brings model capability into engineering workflows through the terminal.

description.zh: 官方说明其可搜索和读取代码、编辑文件、编写并运行测试。
description.en: Anthropic states it can search and read code, edit files, write and run tests.

description.zh: 命令和代码变更应在用户的权限边界下执行。
description.en: Commands and code changes should execute within user-controlled permission boundaries.

description.zh: 适合在终端中委派较大的工程任务。
description.en: It is designed for delegating substantial engineering work from the terminal.

description.zh: 搜索文件和调用关系，辅助开发者理解陌生项目。
description.en: Search files and call paths to help developers understand unfamiliar projects.

description.zh: 修改后运行已有测试，缩小缺陷修复风险。
description.en: Run existing tests after edits to reduce fix risk.

description.zh: 提出重构方案并由工程师审查范围和结果。
description.en: Draft refactors for engineers to review for scope and correctness.

limitations.zh: 对大型或模糊任务应拆分并持续审查。
limitations.en: Large or ambiguous tasks should be decomposed and continually reviewed.

limitations.zh: 不能将其输出视为自动正确的生产代码。
limitations.en: Its output is not automatically production-correct code.

summary.zh: 可读取代码、修改文件、运行测试并在用户控制下调用命令行工具。
summary.en: Reads code, edits files and runs tests with user-controlled command tools.

items.zh: 从工作目录和任务目标开始，沿调用链查看相关文件。
items.en: Start from the workspace and task goal, then follow relevant code paths.

items.zh: 完成后审查差异、测试与解释，决定是否提交。
items.en: Review diffs, tests and explanation before deciding to commit.

summary.zh: 终端是重要入口，官方同时提供 IDE、桌面与网页等接入说明。
summary.en: The terminal is a major interface; official documentation also covers IDE, desktop and web access.

items.zh: 本地文件、命令、外部工具和远程环境需要分别授权。
items.en: Scope local files, commands, external tools and remote environments separately.

items.zh: 它是使用模型完成任务的产品，不是 Claude 基础模型本身。
items.en: It is a product that uses models for tasks, distinct from Claude model releases.

summary.zh: 适合代码仓库维护和可测试的多步骤开发任务。
summary.en: Evaluate it on repository maintenance and testable multistep development.

items.zh: 准备项目约定、构建步骤及验收测试，减少隐含条件。
items.en: Provide project conventions, build steps and acceptance tests.

items.zh: 对部署、数据修改等副作用单独设定控制，不能仅凭测试通过批准。
items.en: Set controls for deployment and data changes separately from test success.

summary.zh: Google 发布的开源终端 AI Agent，将 Gemini 能力带入编码、问题解决和任务管理工作流。
summary.en: Google's open-source terminal AI agent bringing Gemini to coding, problem-solving and task management workflows.

capabilities.zh: 终端交互
代码与问题解决
开源分发

introduction.zh: Gemini CLI 是 Google 发布的开源终端 Agent。
introduction.en: Gemini CLI is Google's open-source terminal agent.

introduction.zh: 它面向开发、问题解决与任务管理，使用前需要根据个人账户或 API/云平台配置核对访问范围。
introduction.en: It targets development, problem solving and task management; access depends on account or API/cloud configuration.

significance.zh: Gemini CLI 提供了将 Gemini 模型能力接入本地开发终端的官方入口。
significance.en: Gemini CLI is Google's official entry point for bringing Gemini into local developer terminals.

description.zh: Google 将其定义为把 Gemini 直接带入终端的开源 AI Agent。
description.en: Google describes it as an open-source AI agent bringing Gemini directly into the terminal.

description.zh: 官方说明覆盖编码、问题解决和任务管理。
description.en: The official announcement covers coding, problem solving and task management.

description.zh: 个人账号、AI Studio 和 Vertex AI 的访问配置不同。
description.en: Personal account, AI Studio and Vertex AI access configurations differ.

description.zh: 在命令行中处理代码解释、生成和修改建议。
description.en: Handle code explanation, generation and change proposals in the command line.

description.zh: 将自然语言问题转换为可执行的开发步骤。
description.en: Turn natural-language questions into executable development steps.

description.zh: 结合项目测试和人工审查验证小范围原型。
description.en: Combine project tests and human review for scoped prototypes.

limitations.zh: 开源客户端不代表所有模型、配额或云权限都免费。
limitations.en: An open-source client does not make every model, quota or cloud permission free.

limitations.zh: 本地命令和文件访问仍需要明确的权限边界。
limitations.en: Local commands and file access still need explicit permission boundaries.

summary.zh: 开源终端 Agent 将模型推理与命令、文件和开发任务结合。
summary.en: An open-source terminal agent combines model reasoning with commands, files and developer tasks.

items.zh: 从项目目录发起任务，说明目标和验证命令。
items.en: Start in the project directory and provide goals and validation commands.

items.zh: 查看文件修改与执行结果，再决定后续操作。
items.en: Inspect file changes and execution results before proceeding.

summary.zh: CLI 的开源许可、模型服务身份和调用额度属于不同层次。
summary.en: CLI licensing, model-service authentication and quotas are separate concerns.

items.zh: 按官方说明配置身份与模型，确认网络服务的数据路径。
items.en: Configure identity and models using official instructions and check data paths.

items.zh: 扩展外部工具时核对权限和可信度。
items.en: Review permissions and trust when adding external tools.

summary.zh: 适合偏好终端工作流和工具扩展的开发者。
summary.en: Evaluate it for terminal workflows and tool extensions.

items.zh: 开源客户端不意味着模型调用免费或可离线运行。
items.en: An open-source client does not imply free or offline model inference.

items.zh: 用实际项目任务比较正确性、延迟和授权负担。
items.en: Compare correctness, latency and permission overhead on actual tasks.

summary.zh: 自主通用 AI Agent，官方文档将其描述为能在沙箱环境中规划、执行并交付任务成果的产品。
summary.en: Autonomous general AI agent described by its documentation as planning, executing and delivering task outcomes in a sandbox environment.

capabilities.zh: 任务规划与执行
沙箱工作环境
持久文件系统

introduction.zh: Manus 是面向端到端任务交付的通用 Agent 产品。
introduction.en: Manus is a general agent product for end-to-end task delivery.

introduction.zh: 它的文档强调沙箱环境、文件系统和工具安装能力；实际可用能力仍取决于任务、权限和账户配置。
introduction.en: Its documentation emphasizes sandboxes, filesystems and tool installation; practical capability still depends on task, permissions and account configuration.

significance.zh: Manus 将通用 Agent 的价值定位在完成任务产物，而不是仅给出对话回复。
significance.en: Manus positions general-agent value around delivered work products rather than chat responses alone.

description.zh: 官方文档将其描述为可以规划、执行并交付完整工作成果的 Agent。
description.en: The official documentation describes an agent that can plan, execute and deliver complete work products.

description.zh: 文档提到独立虚拟计算机、网络和持久文件系统。
description.en: The documentation describes a virtual computer, network access and persistent filesystem.

description.zh: 应根据工具授权和任务范围评估它能否实际完成目标。
description.en: Assess completion against tool authorization and task scope.

description.zh: 在授权来源范围内收集并整理任务材料。
description.en: Collect and organize task material within authorized sources.

description.zh: 把多步骤流程组织为可检查的任务。
description.en: Organize multi-step processes into inspectable tasks.

description.zh: 生成文档、表格或其他工作产物，并保留核验步骤。
description.en: Create documents, tables or other work products while retaining verification steps.

limitations.zh: 自主执行不等于可绕过权限、隐私和人工审查。
limitations.en: Autonomy does not bypass permissions, privacy or human review.

limitations.zh: 外部网络和工具结果应单独核验。
limitations.en: External network and tool results should be verified independently.

summary.zh: 以明确任务交付研究、网站、演示稿等成果。
summary.en: Delivers research, websites and presentations from scoped tasks.

items.zh: 说明输入资料、输出格式和验收标准。
items.en: Specify input material, output format and acceptance criteria.

items.zh: 查看执行过程和最终成果，对研究引用逐项复核。
items.en: Inspect progress and final artifacts and verify research citations.

summary.zh: 网页、下载、团队和 API 入口对应不同使用方式。
summary.en: Web, downloads, teams and API entry points serve different workflows.

items.zh: 外部连接与工作资料需要按任务核对权限。
items.en: Review external connections and work-data permissions per task.

items.zh: 采用前阅读当前服务、隐私与信任资料。
items.en: Read current service, privacy and trust documentation before adoption.

summary.zh: 用可验收的任务评估综合执行能力，避免以宣传任务列表代替效果评估。
summary.en: Assess execution using reviewable tasks rather than a marketing task list.

items.zh: 同时记录正确性、引用完整度、人工修订和任务成本。
items.en: Record correctness, citation completeness, revisions and task cost.

items.zh: 长任务仍需设置阶段检查与退出条件。
items.en: Define progress checkpoints and stopping conditions for long tasks.

summary.zh: Cognition 提供的 AI 软件工程产品，官方文档描述其可编写、运行和测试代码，并提供 IDE、终端和浏览器工作区。
summary.en: Cognition's AI software engineering product that can write, run and test code with an IDE, shell and browser workspace.

capabilities.zh: 代码编写、运行和测试
IDE、终端和浏览器工作区
并行小任务

introduction.zh: Devin 是 AI 软件工程产品，面向代码实现、测试、排错和工程任务管理。
introduction.en: Devin is an AI software engineering product for implementation, testing, debugging and engineering task management.

introduction.zh: 官方文档强调对小范围、边界明确的任务效果更好；复杂任务仍需要拆分、评审和验证。
introduction.en: Its documentation emphasizes better outcomes on clear, scoped tasks; complex work still needs decomposition, review and verification.

significance.zh: Devin 将 Agent、IDE、终端和浏览器组合为可观察的软件工程工作区。
significance.en: Devin combines an agent, IDE, shell and browser into an observable engineering workspace.

description.zh: 官方文档称其能够编写、运行和测试代码。
description.en: Official documentation states it can write, run and test code.

description.zh: 用户可以在嵌入式 IDE、终端和浏览器中查看或接管工作。
description.en: Users can observe or take over work in an embedded IDE, shell and browser.

description.zh: 文档建议将复杂工作拆为隔离的小任务。
description.en: The documentation recommends splitting complex work into isolated smaller tasks.

description.zh: 处理范围清晰的前端、缺陷和测试覆盖任务。
description.en: Handle scoped frontend, bug and test-coverage work.

description.zh: 先拆解迁移，再通过测试和代码评审验证。
description.en: Decompose migrations first, then validate through tests and review.

description.zh: 复现并定位失败，但发布前仍需维护者批准。
description.en: Reproduce and diagnose failures while retaining maintainer approval before release.

limitations.zh: 复杂或模糊问题不应直接交给单个长任务。
limitations.en: Complex or ambiguous problems should not be handed to one long task unchanged.

limitations.zh: 自动生成的代码需要安全、测试和架构审查。
limitations.en: Generated code requires security, testing and architecture review.

summary.zh: 将软件任务交给可执行开发流程的 Agent，并由团队审查结果。
summary.en: Delegate executable software workflows to an agent and review results as a team.

items.zh: 准备仓库、环境、需求和可运行的验收步骤。
items.en: Prepare a repository, environment, requirements and executable acceptance steps.

items.zh: 在任务记录与代码差异中核对实际完成范围。
items.en: Check actual scope in task records and code diffs.

summary.zh: 配置开发环境和仓库权限是使用任务产品的前提。
summary.en: Development environment and repository permissions are prerequisites for task execution.

items.zh: 给出依赖安装、测试和调试方式，确认秘密信息处理。
items.en: Provide dependency, test and debugging steps and check secret handling.

items.zh: 把运行权限与代码合并、部署权限分开控制。
items.en: Control execution separately from merge and deployment permissions.

summary.zh: 从边界清晰的维护、修复或重构任务开始比较。
summary.en: Start with scoped maintenance, fixes or refactoring tasks.

items.zh: 按任务成功率、回滚成本与人工审查耗时评估。
items.en: Evaluate success, rollback cost and human review time.

items.zh: 产品能执行任务并不等于可无人验收地合并。
items.en: Task execution does not establish readiness for unreviewed merges.

summary.zh: 用于构建、管理和部署长运行、有状态 Agent 的低层编排框架与运行时。
summary.en: Low-level orchestration framework and runtime for long-running, stateful agents.

capabilities.zh: 持久执行
人工介入
状态管理

introduction.zh: LangGraph 是面向复杂、有状态 Agent 的低层编排框架。
introduction.en: LangGraph is a low-level orchestration framework for complex, stateful agents.

introduction.zh: 它可以独立使用，也常与 LangChain 组件配合；应根据是否需要持久执行和精细状态控制选择。
introduction.en: It can be used standalone or with LangChain components; choose it when durable execution and fine-grained state control matter.

significance.zh: LangGraph 将 Agent 工作流中的状态、恢复和人工介入显式化。
significance.en: LangGraph makes agent workflow state, recovery and human intervention explicit.

description.zh: 官方概览将其定位为 Agent 编排运行时。
description.en: The official overview positions it as an agent orchestration runtime.

description.zh: 重点能力包括持久执行、流式处理、人工介入和记忆。
description.en: Highlighted capabilities include durable execution, streaming, human oversight and memory.

description.zh: 使用 LangGraph 不要求同时采用 LangChain。
description.en: Using LangGraph does not require adopting LangChain.

description.zh: 处理可恢复、可暂停的多步骤工作流。
description.en: Handle resumable, pausable multi-step workflows.

description.zh: 在关键状态节点加入人工审核。
description.en: Add human approval at critical state transitions.

description.zh: 查看 Agent 状态与流程路径，辅助调试。
description.en: Inspect agent state and paths to support debugging.

limitations.zh: 低层抽象需要团队自行设计状态和错误处理。
limitations.en: Low-level abstractions require teams to design their own state and error handling.

limitations.zh: 框架本身不保证底层模型事实正确。
limitations.en: The framework itself does not guarantee factual correctness from the underlying model.

summary.zh: 面向有状态、长运行 Agent 的低层编排与运行时。
summary.en: A low-level runtime and orchestration layer for stateful, long-running agents.

items.zh: 先定义共享状态、节点职责和边，再设计执行流。
items.en: Define shared state, node responsibilities and edges before execution flow.

items.zh: 把任务进度与下一步决策显式记录在状态中。
items.en: Record task progress and next-step decisions explicitly in state.

summary.zh: 运行控制需要结合持久化、恢复和人工介入设计。
summary.en: Design execution control around persistence, recovery and human intervention.

items.zh: 明确中断点、状态存储与失败重试策略。
items.en: Define interruption points, state storage and retries.

items.zh: 恢复执行前核对外部操作是否已经发生，避免重复副作用。
items.en: Check whether external operations already happened before resuming.

summary.zh: 适合需要精细控制状态与执行路径的 Agent 系统。
summary.en: Suits agents needing explicit state and execution-path control.

items.zh: 简单一次问答不一定需要图编排；按流程复杂度选择。
items.en: One-shot chat may not need graph orchestration; choose based on workflow complexity.

items.zh: 用中断、恢复和工具失败场景验证系统。
items.en: Validate interruption, recovery and tool-failure scenarios.

summary.zh: Microsoft 维护的开源 Agent 框架，提供核心运行时、模型客户端扩展和可选代码执行能力。
summary.en: Microsoft-maintained open-source agent framework with a core runtime, model-client extensions and optional code execution.

capabilities.zh: Agent 运行时
模型客户端扩展
可选代码执行器

introduction.zh: AutoGen 是用于构建 Agent 应用的开源框架。
introduction.en: AutoGen is an open-source framework for building agent applications.

introduction.zh: 其安装文档覆盖核心运行时、模型扩展和可选 Docker 代码执行器，实际安全边界由部署者配置。
introduction.en: Its installation documentation covers the core runtime, model extensions and optional Docker executors; deployers configure the real security boundary.

significance.zh: AutoGen 为 Agent 运行时、模型连接和执行器提供了可组合的工程入口。
significance.en: AutoGen provides composable engineering entry points for agent runtime, model connectivity and executors.

description.zh: 官方安装文档提供 autogen-core 作为核心包。
description.en: Official installation documentation provides autogen-core as the core package.

description.zh: OpenAI 与 Azure OpenAI 等模型连接通过扩展安装。
description.en: Model connections such as OpenAI and Azure OpenAI are installed through extensions.

description.zh: 文档建议代码执行可使用 Docker 执行器。
description.en: The documentation recommends Docker executors for code execution.

description.zh: 快速验证模型、工具和消息协作机制。
description.en: Quickly validate models, tools and message collaboration.

description.zh: 在隔离环境中运行模型生成的代码。
description.en: Run model-generated code in isolated environments.

description.zh: 通过客户端扩展连接不同模型提供方。
description.en: Connect multiple model providers through client extensions.

limitations.zh: 执行器与模型密钥配置不当会扩大安全风险。
limitations.en: Misconfigured executors and model credentials can expand security risk.

limitations.zh: 需要自行建设评估、审计和生产可观测性。
limitations.en: Evaluation, audit and production observability remain deployment responsibilities.

summary.zh: AutoGen Core 提供事件驱动 Agent 运行机制与模型客户端扩展。
summary.en: AutoGen Core provides event-driven agent runtime and model-client extensions.

items.zh: 明确每个 Agent 的职责、消息类型和交互协议。
items.en: Define each agent's responsibilities, message types and interaction protocol.

items.zh: 按需求选择核心层与更高层协作接口。
items.en: Choose core or higher-level collaboration interfaces to fit the task.

summary.zh: 可选代码执行器和外部工具应作为受控能力接入。
summary.en: Integrate optional code executors and external tools as controlled capabilities.

items.zh: 为执行环境配置资源限制、隔离和可访问数据。
items.en: Configure resource limits, isolation and accessible data for execution.

items.zh: 记录模型消息、工具参数和结果用于定位错误。
items.en: Record model messages, tool parameters and results for debugging.

summary.zh: 多个 Agent 参与不自动提高准确性，需要明确终止和验收机制。
summary.en: More agents do not automatically improve accuracy; define termination and review.

items.zh: 测试协作循环、超时、重复消息和失败恢复。
items.en: Test loops, timeouts, repeated messages and recovery.

items.zh: 对照单 Agent 基线比较完成率与成本。
items.en: Compare completion and cost against a single-agent baseline.

summary.zh: 用于构建协作式 Agent、Crew 与 Flow 的 Agent 编排框架。
summary.en: Agent orchestration framework for collaborative agents, crews and flows.

capabilities.zh: Agent 与工具组合
Crew 与 Flow 编排
Guardrail 与记忆

introduction.zh: CrewAI 将协作式 Agent、Crew 和 Flow 作为主要构建块。
introduction.en: CrewAI uses collaborative agents, crews and flows as primary building blocks.

introduction.zh: 它适合表达顺序、分层或混合流程，但生产可靠性仍取决于模型、工具权限和评估。
introduction.en: It supports sequential, hierarchical and hybrid flows, while production reliability still depends on models, tool permissions and evaluation.

significance.zh: CrewAI 用角色、任务和流程组织多 Agent 协作。
significance.en: CrewAI organizes multi-agent collaboration through roles, tasks and flows.

description.zh: 官方文档将 Agents、Crews 和 Flows 作为核心概念。
description.en: Official documentation presents agents, crews and flows as core concepts.

description.zh: Flow 支持状态、路由、持久执行与恢复。
description.en: Flows support state, routing, persistence and resumption.

description.zh: 文档强调 guardrails、memory、knowledge 和 observability。
description.en: The documentation emphasizes guardrails, memory, knowledge and observability.

description.zh: 让不同角色处理检索、整理和复核步骤。
description.en: Assign retrieval, synthesis and review to different roles.

description.zh: 组合触发器、任务和人工介入。
description.en: Combine triggers, tasks and human intervention.

description.zh: 使用结构化结果约束 Agent 产物。
description.en: Constrain agent deliverables with structured results.

limitations.zh: 角色数量不等于可靠性，复杂流程仍需评估。
limitations.en: More roles do not equal reliability; complex flows still need evaluation.

limitations.zh: 工具和外部系统连接必须实施最小权限。
limitations.en: Tool and external-system connections require least privilege.

summary.zh: 用角色、任务与流程组织协作式 Agent。
summary.en: Organize collaborative agents using roles, tasks and flows.

items.zh: 将角色职责和交付结果写清，避免多个角色重复处理同一任务。
items.en: Define responsibilities and outputs to avoid duplicated work.

items.zh: 用流程约束任务先后、状态和分支条件。
items.en: Constrain ordering, state and branches using flows.

summary.zh: 工具调用与流程状态需要与模型输出共同验证。
summary.en: Validate tool calls and flow state alongside model output.

items.zh: 显式定义工具输入输出、权限与错误处理。
items.en: Define tool schemas, permissions and error handling.

items.zh: 为长期执行保存可恢复的任务状态和日志。
items.en: Preserve recoverable task state and logs for long-running execution.

summary.zh: 适合分工清晰的任务链和多角色协作试验。
summary.en: Evaluate it for well-defined task chains and role-based collaboration.

items.zh: 衡量每一阶段输出质量，而非仅看最终回复。
items.en: Measure output quality at each stage rather than just the final response.

items.zh: 额外 Agent 会增加调用成本，先建立简单流程基线。
items.en: Extra agents add model-call cost; establish a simple baseline first.

summary.zh: 用于构建 Agent 应用的轻量 Python SDK，提供 Agent、工具、Handoff、Guardrail、会话和追踪能力。
summary.en: Lightweight Python SDK for agentic applications with agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions and tracing.

capabilities.zh: 函数工具
Handoff 与 Agent-as-tool
Guardrail 与追踪

introduction.zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 是构建 Agent 应用的 Python SDK。
introduction.en: The OpenAI Agents SDK is a Python SDK for agentic applications.

introduction.zh: 它在模型调用之上提供 Agent 循环、工具、handoff、guardrail、会话和追踪等编排能力。
introduction.en: It provides an agent loop, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions and tracing above model calls.

significance.zh: 该 SDK 为 OpenAI 模型上的 Agent 运行时提供了较小且可组合的抽象集合。
significance.en: The SDK supplies a small, composable set of runtime abstractions for agents on OpenAI models.

description.zh: 文档列出 Agent、工具、handoff 和 guardrail 等核心原语。
description.en: Documentation lists agents, tools, handoffs and guardrails as core primitives.

description.zh: 内置 Agent loop 可管理工具调用并继续执行直到完成。
description.en: The built-in agent loop can manage tool calls and continue until completion.

description.zh: SDK 提供 tracing，用于可视化和调试 Agent 流程。
description.en: The SDK provides tracing for visualizing and debugging agent flows.

description.zh: 为模型接入经过模式校验的函数工具。
description.en: Connect schema-validated function tools to models.

description.zh: 根据任务选择 manager 或 handoff 模式。
description.en: Choose manager or handoff patterns per task.

description.zh: 记录追踪并用评估检查输出。
description.en: Capture traces and evaluate outputs.

limitations.zh: SDK 不能替代工具权限、数据治理和业务评估。
limitations.en: The SDK does not replace tool permissions, data governance or product evaluation.

limitations.zh: Agent 设计需要控制成本、失败恢复和人工介入。
limitations.en: Agent design still needs cost control, failure recovery and human oversight.

summary.zh: Python SDK 提供 Agent、工具、handoff、guardrail 与运行追踪。
summary.en: The Python SDK provides agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails and tracing.

items.zh: 定义 instructions 与工具，再使用 Runner 推进任务。
items.en: Define instructions and tools, then use Runner to advance tasks.

items.zh: 将 handoff 用于职责转交，明确接收任务的上下文。
items.en: Use handoffs for responsibility transfer and define the receiving context.

summary.zh: 会话、检查与追踪帮助管理运行，但业务权限仍需自行配置。
summary.en: Sessions, checks and tracing support runs; business permissions still need configuration.

items.zh: 在工具侧检查参数、身份、数据范围和副作用。
items.en: Validate parameters, identity, data scope and side effects in tools.

items.zh: 敏感操作设置人工确认或独立授权条件。
items.en: Set human review or separate authorization for sensitive operations.

summary.zh: 适合在自己的应用中构建受控 Agent 流程。
summary.en: Suits controlled agent workflows embedded in your own application.

items.zh: 测试 handoff、工具失败、超时与会话恢复。
items.en: Test handoffs, tool failures, timeouts and session recovery.

items.zh: SDK 是开发组件，不能与完整工作台按相同产品层次比较。
items.en: The SDK is a development component, distinct from a complete workbench.

summary.zh: 面向文档、表格、数据分析和研究任务的 AI 办公工作台，可处理授权的本地文件并交付成果。
summary.en: An AI workbench for documents, spreadsheets, analysis and research, with authorized local-file access.

introduction.zh: 面向文档、表格、数据分析和研究任务的 AI 办公工作台，可处理授权的本地文件并交付成果。
introduction.en: An AI workbench for documents, spreadsheets, analysis and research, with authorized local-file access.

significance.zh: 按任务、使用入口和权限范围比较，并查看原始资料。
significance.en: Compare task fit, interfaces and permissions using original sources.

description.zh: 官方列出文档生成、数据分析、演示稿和批量文件处理。
description.en: Official use cases include documents, data analysis, presentations and batch file work.

description.zh: 腾讯公告列出 WorkBuddy 可体验 Hy4 preview；实际可用模型以应用内为准。
description.en: Tencent lists WorkBuddy as an interface to Hy4 preview; check current availability in the app.

description.zh: 内置模型与自定义 API 是不同接入路径，模型选择会影响处理数据的提供方。
description.en: Built-in models and custom APIs have different providers and data paths.

description.zh: 核对生成文档、表格和演示稿的结构与内容。
description.en: Review the structure and contents of generated office files.

description.zh: 检查研究报告的引用，以及文件整理的变更。
description.en: Check report citations and file-organizing changes.

limitations.zh: 授权文件范围后再执行；产物和数据分析结论仍需验收。
limitations.en: Authorize file scope before execution and review results.

limitations.zh: 主要按办公用途归组，具备 Agent 能力不代表它是基础模型或开发框架。
limitations.en: Its primary browse purpose is office work; agent features do not make it a model or framework.

summary.zh: 把办公任务写成输入、处理步骤和交付物，再在工作区查看执行过程。
summary.en: Define inputs, processing and deliverables, then inspect progress in the workspace.

items.zh: 指定文档、表格或目录及目标格式；文件批处理先确认范围。
items.en: Specify documents, spreadsheets or folders and output formats; confirm scope before batch work.

items.zh: 检查生成文档的结构、数据分析计算和研究报告引用。
items.en: Check document structure, analysis calculations and research citations.

summary.zh: 内置模型与自定义 API 是不同接入路径，模型选择会影响处理数据的提供方。
summary.en: Built-in models and custom APIs have different providers and data paths.

items.zh: 腾讯公告列出 Hy4 preview 接入；模型菜单可能继续变化。
items.en: Tencent lists Hy4 preview access; model menus may evolve.

items.zh: 自定义模型可连接第三方 API 或本地服务；配置保存在本地不代表所有推理都在本机。
items.en: Custom models can use third-party APIs or local services; local configuration does not imply local inference.

summary.zh: 适合需要产出文件的办公与研究任务；执行权限由实际任务决定。
summary.en: Best evaluated on office and research tasks that produce files; scope permissions per task.

items.zh: 用同一份脱敏样例比较不同模型的正确性、完成时间与调用成本。
items.en: Compare models using one sanitized sample, correctness, elapsed time and call cost.

items.zh: 整理文件前保留副本，执行完成后逐项核对产物与变更。
items.en: Keep a copy before organizing files and review artifacts and changes afterwards.

summary.zh: 中国版入口：TraeCode 的现有官方入口已升级为融合 TraeCode 与 TraeWork 的 TRAE，提供桌面 Agent/IDE 窗口及网页、移动入口；保留旧名称以便查阅历史。
summary.en: Chinese-edition entry: The former TraeCode entry now documents unified TRAE, combining TraeCode and TraeWork with desktop Agent/IDE windows and web/mobile access; the old name is retained for historical navigation.

introduction.zh: 中国版入口：TraeCode 的现有官方入口已升级为融合 TraeCode 与 TraeWork 的 TRAE，提供桌面 Agent/IDE 窗口及网页、移动入口；保留旧名称以便查阅历史。
introduction.en: Chinese-edition entry: The former TraeCode entry now documents unified TRAE, combining TraeCode and TraeWork with desktop Agent/IDE windows and web/mobile access; the old name is retained for historical navigation.

significance.zh: 按任务、使用入口和权限范围比较，并查看原始资料。
significance.en: Compare task fit, interfaces and permissions using original sources.

description.zh: 当前 TRAE 桌面端具有 Agent 与 IDE 窗口；IDE 窗口内再分 IDE 与 SOLO 模式。
description.en: Current TRAE desktop has Agent and IDE windows; IDE and SOLO are modes within the IDE window.

description.zh: 支持自定义模型 API Key，并为智能体配置工具与 MCP Server。
description.en: Supports custom model API keys and agent tools including MCP servers.

description.zh: 自定义模型、MCP Server 与命令执行具有不同权限和数据边界。
description.en: Custom models, MCP servers and commands have distinct permission and data boundaries.

description.zh: 理解上下文，修改代码并运行测试、审查差异。
description.en: Inspect context, edit code, run tests and review diffs.

description.zh: 把需求拆解为可验证的开发步骤。
description.en: Break requirements into verifiable development steps.

limitations.zh: 与 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 按编程用途一起比较；具体入口、权限和控制方式分别核对。
limitations.en: Compare with Cursor, Claude Code and Codex by coding purpose; verify interfaces, permissions and control separately.

limitations.zh: AI 生成的代码、命令和变更仍需测试与审查。
limitations.en: Generated code, commands and changes require testing and review.

limitations.zh: 官方已公告产品融合；旧版界面和模式不可直接当作当前入口，准确迁移日期未核实。
limitations.en: A product merger is announced; old interfaces and modes do not establish current access, and the exact migration date has not been established.

limitations.zh: 本页中国版资料与国际站的产品、套餐和模式分别判断；不把一个地区的升级公告套到另一地区。
limitations.en: Chinese-edition documentation and international-site products, plans and modes are assessed separately; a regional upgrade does not establish changes in another region.

title.zh: IDE 与 SOLO 工作流

summary.zh: IDE 适合在编辑器中连续修改；SOLO 适合以任务组织规划、执行和验收。
summary.en: IDE supports iterative editing; SOLO organizes planning, execution and review around tasks.

items.zh: 从项目上下文、需求和失败测试开始，审查每次文件差异。
items.en: Start with project context, requirements and failing tests; review diffs.

items.zh: 将运行、调试、Git 和代码审查结合，避免只检查生成文本。
items.en: Combine execution, debugging, Git and review rather than checking generated text alone.

summary.zh: 自定义模型、MCP Server 与命令执行具有不同权限和数据边界。
summary.en: Custom models, MCP servers and commands have distinct permission and data boundaries.

items.zh: 配置模型 API Key 与 MCP 工具时确认服务端和可读取的数据。
items.en: Check providers and readable data when configuring API keys and MCP tools.

items.zh: 沙箱和审批用于控制文件与命令；自动审批设置需要结合项目风险选择。
items.en: Sandboxing and approvals control files and commands; choose automatic approvals to fit the project.

summary.zh: 它与 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 都面向软件任务，比较重点是工作入口和执行控制。
summary.en: It shares software workflows with Cursor, Claude Code and Codex; compare interfaces and execution controls.

items.zh: 先比较编辑器协作、任务执行、远程环境和团队审查需求。
items.en: Compare editor collaboration, task execution, remote environments and team review needs.

items.zh: 用同一仓库任务评估修改正确性；具有 Agent 能力不构成单独的互斥分类。
items.en: Evaluate correctness on the same repository task; agent capability is not a mutually exclusive category.

summary.zh: 中国版入口：TraeWork 是现已升级为 TRAE 的历史产品入口。旧概览保留桌面、网页、移动和云端任务说明；当前功能应在新版 TRAE 核对。
summary.en: Chinese-edition entry: TraeWork is a historical product entry now upgraded to TRAE. Its old overview retains desktop, web, mobile and cloud-task descriptions; current features should be checked in unified TRAE.

introduction.zh: 中国版入口：TraeWork 是现已升级为 TRAE 的历史产品入口。旧概览保留桌面、网页、移动和云端任务说明；当前功能应在新版 TRAE 核对。
introduction.en: Chinese-edition entry: TraeWork is a historical product entry now upgraded to TRAE. Its old overview retains desktop, web, mobile and cloud-task descriptions; current features should be checked in unified TRAE.

significance.zh: 按任务、使用入口和权限范围比较，并查看原始资料。
significance.en: Compare task fit, interfaces and permissions using original sources.

description.zh: 旧 TraeWork 概览提示已升级为 TRAE；不把两者继续呈现为当前互相独立的产品。
description.en: The old TraeWork overview announces its upgrade to TRAE; they are not presented as currently independent products.

description.zh: 旧概览记录桌面、网页、移动入口和云端隔离环境；这是旧产品说明，当前权限与模式需要重新核对。
description.en: The former overview documents desktop, web, mobile and isolated cloud environments; current permissions and modes require a fresh check.

description.zh: 检查文档、数据和演示稿的最终成果。
description.en: Review final documents, data and presentations.

description.zh: 从不同入口下发、查看并验收任务。
description.en: Assign, monitor and review tasks across interfaces.

limitations.zh: 旧模式说明不能作为新版功能承诺；产品升级也不证明特定账号已经可用。
limitations.en: Former modes do not promise current features; the upgrade announcement does not establish access for a specific account.

limitations.zh: 具体迁移日期与旧入口停止服务日期尚未核实，不编造下线事件。
limitations.en: The exact migration and old-service shutdown dates are not established; no shutdown event is invented.

introduction.zh: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite 属于独立的 Flash-Lite 产品线，优先目标是低延迟、低成本和高吞吐，不应与 Flash 或 Pro 当成同一档位。
introduction.en: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite is a separate product line optimized for latency, cost, and throughput, and should not be treated as the same tier as Flash or Pro.

significance.zh: 它提供百万 token 上下文和完整多模态输入，但重点是规模化轻量任务而非最高单次任务质量。
significance.en: It provides a million-token context and broad multimodal input, but targets scaled lightweight work rather than maximum per-task quality.

description.zh: 适合高频、轻量、成本敏感任务，应与 Flash 和 Pro 分开评估。
description.en: For frequent, lightweight, cost-sensitive work; evaluate separately from Flash and Pro.

description.zh: 适合分类、提取、翻译和子 Agent 执行。
description.en: For classification, extraction, translation, and subagent execution.

limitations.zh: 不以最高复杂推理质量为首要目标。
limitations.en: It is not optimized primarily for maximum complex-reasoning quality.

limitations.zh: 生产采用仍需以真实吞吐、延迟和质量做任务级评测。
limitations.en: Production adoption still requires task-level throughput, latency, and quality evaluation.

evidence.sourceExcerpt: The official K3 launch blog lists $0.30/MTok cache-hit input, $3.00/MTok cache-miss input and $15.00/MTok output. These are launch-reference rates, not a replacement for the current dynamic pricing table.
Current general models include GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna; specialized image and speech models have separate APIs.
API release records: GPT-5.5 and Pro April 24, 2026; GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna July 9; Realtime 2.1 July 6; Transcribe July 28; GPT-6 Astra September 3, Sol/Luna September 22, 6.1 Sol September 29.
GPT-4.5 Preview was shut down on July 14, 2025. The GPT-4o May 13, 2024 snapshot is scheduled to shut down on October 23, 2026.
Current tiers are Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 4.5; current models accept text/images and produce text.
Sonnet 3.5 and Sonnet 4 are retired on the Claude API; Sonnet 4.5 is deprecated with retirement scheduled for November 30, 2026.

## Pricing

Pricing is based on the number of tokens used, or other metrics based on the model type. For tool-specific models, like search and computer use, there’s a fee per tool call. See details in the [pricing page](/api/docs/pricing).

### Text tokens

| Metric | Price | Unit |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Input | $2.5 | 1M tokens |
| Cached input | $1.25 | 1M tokens |
| Output | $10 | 1M tokens |

## Endpoints

| Endpoint | Route | Support |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Live | `v1/live/sessions` | Not supported |
| Chat Completions | `v1/chat/completions` | Supported |
| Responses | `v1/responses` | Supported |
| Realtime | `v1/realtime` | Not supported |
| Realtime translation | `v1/realtime/translations` | Not supported |
| Realtime transcription | `v1/realtime/transcription_sessions` | Not supported |
| Assistants | `v1/assistants` | Supported |
| Batch | `v1/batch` | Supported |
| Fine-tuning | `v1/fine-tuning` | Supported |
| Embeddings | `v1/embeddings` | Not supported |
| Image generation | `v1/images/generations` | Not supported

---
title: Context windows
url: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows
description: Understand how the context window works, how extended thinking and tool use count toward it, and how to manage context as conversations grow.
---

As conversations grow, you'll eventually approach context window limits. For long-running conversations and agentic workflows, [server-side compaction](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/compaction) is the primary strategy for context management.

## How the context window works

The "context window" refers to all the text a language model can reference when generating a response, including the response itself. This is different from the large corpus of data the language model was trained on, and instead represents a "working memory" for the model. A larger context window allows the model to handle more complex and lengthy prompts, but more context isn't automatically better. As token count grows, accuracy and recall degrade, a phenomenon known as *context rot*. This makes curating what's in context just as important as how much space is available.

模型调用默认 按量计费 ，涵盖各类模型的计费规则与价格。
说明本文仅展示模型调用原价，请前往百炼控制台查看活动优惠。
说明部分模型支持上下文缓存（显式缓存、隐式缓存）。缓存命中的输入 Token 及创建显式缓存的 Token 采用与标准输入不同的计费单价（例如显式缓存创建按标准输入单价的 125% 计费、命中按 10% 计费），本文价格表中的输入单价不含缓存单价。缓存的计费规则、单价折扣及支持的模型请参见上下文缓存。
阶梯计费规则 
百炼部分模型实行阶梯计费。单价取决于单次请求的输入 Token 总量。该请求的所有 Token 均按对应阶梯的单价结算。
计费区间中的 K 表示 1,000，M 表示 1,000,000。例如，128K 即 128,000 Token，256K 即 256,000 Token，1M 即 1,000,000 Token。
例如，某模型设有两档计费区间：0 < Token ≤ 32K 和 32K < Token ≤ 128K。若输入 100K Token，因数值落在第二区间（32K < 100K ≤ 128K），所有 Token 均按第二档单价结算。
文本生成-千问 
千问Max 
计费规则：按输入Token和输出Token计费。
影响计费的因素：若模型支持Batch调用，其输入和输出Token单价均按实时推理价格的50%计费；若模型支持上下文缓存，仅输入Token享有折扣。两者不能同时生效。

ls. At the same time, K2 Thinking is a native INT4 quantization model with 256k context window, achieving lossless reductions in inference latency and GPU memory usage.

### Key Features
- **Deep Thinking & Tool Orchestration**: End-to-end trained to interleave chain-of-thought reasoning with function calls, enabling autonomous research, coding, and writing workflows that last hundreds of steps without drift.
- **Native INT4 Quantization**: Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) is employed in post-training stage to achieve lossless 2x speed-up in low-latency mode.
- **Stable Long-Horizon Agency**: Maintains coherent goal-directed behavior across up to 200–300 consecutive tool invocations, surpassing prior models that degrade after 30–50 steps.

text.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 型号页列出 PDF、图像和文本输入；仍需核验扫描质量、字段保真和缺失信息处理。
text.en: The Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview model page lists PDF, image and text inputs; scan quality, field fidelity and missing information handling still need testing.

text.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 的指定型号页明确支持图像输入；不是图像生成或 OCR 准确率承诺。
text.en: The specific Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview model page lists image input; this is not an image generation or OCR accuracy claim.

text.zh: LangGraph 可用 checkpointer 保存线程图状态；自行编排需配置持久化后端，内存 saver 不保留进程重启后的状态。
text.en: LangGraph checkpointers persist thread graph state; self-managed graphs need a persistent backend because memory savers lose state on restart.

text.zh: LangGraph interrupt 支持暂停等待人工输入再恢复；需 checkpointer、同一 thread_id 和应用审批逻辑，不能据此保证审批不会绕过。
text.en: LangGraph interrupts support pausing for human input and resuming with a checkpointer, the same thread ID and application approval logic; bypass prevention is unmeasured.

text.zh: LangGraph checkpointer 文档说明可从保存的图状态恢复，包括错误状态；需核验重跑节点的副作用与幂等性。
text.en: LangGraph documents checkpoint resumption even from error states; replayed node side effects and idempotency still need testing.

text.zh: LangGraph 文档说明可以在工具执行前暂停，供人检查或编辑调用；实际工具集、权限和错误处理由应用配置。
text.en: LangGraph documents pausing before tool execution to review or edit calls; actual tools, permissions and error handling require application configuration.

text.zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 官方型号页列出结构化输出支持；仍需验证字段准确性、缺失处理与 schema 限制。
text.en: The GPT-6.1 Sol model page lists structured output support; field accuracy, missing values and schema limits remain untested.

text.zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 官方型号页列出文本输出；不代表简历匹配或问答准确性已测。
text.en: The GPT-6.1 Sol model page lists text output, not measured career matching or answer accuracy.

text.zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 的工具调用须使用 Responses API；Chat Completions 不支持该型号的工具调用，不能扩展为所有渠道都支持。
text.en: GPT-6.1 Sol tool calling requires Responses API; Chat Completions does not support its tool calling, and other channels are not established.

text.zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 在 Responses API 中支持 File Search 工具；需要配置文件与检索链路，不是文档答案准确率保证。
text.en: GPT-6.1 Sol supports File Search in Responses API; files and retrieval must be configured, with no answer-accuracy guarantee.

text.zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 官方型号页列出文本和图像输入；不代表 PDF 原生处理或 OCR 效果已测。
text.en: The GPT-6.1 Sol model page lists text and image input, not native PDF support or measured OCR accuracy.

text.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 官方型号页列出结构化输出支持；不证明业务抽取准确性或任意 schema 支持。
text.en: The Gemini 3.8 Flash model page lists structured output support, not extraction accuracy or arbitrary schema support.

text.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 官方型号页列出文本输出；不证明问答或简历匹配效果。
text.en: The Gemini 3.8 Flash model page lists text output, not measured QA or career matching quality.

text.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 官方型号页列出 PDF、图像和文本输入；扫描件、复杂版式与字段保真仍需实测。
text.en: The Gemini 3.8 Flash model page lists PDF, image and text input; scans, complex layouts and field fidelity still require tests.

text.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 官方型号页列出图像输入；不等于图像生成或 OCR 准确率承诺。
text.en: The Gemini 3.8 Flash model page lists image input, not image generation or an OCR accuracy guarantee.

text.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 官方型号页列出 Function calling 支持；工具执行、权限及失败处理仍由应用配置。
text.en: The Gemini 3.8 Flash model page lists function calling support; execution, permissions and failure handling require application configuration.

text.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 的 Google Gemini Developer API Standard 付费 token 报价截至 2026-12-31：每百万输入 0.75 USD、输出（含思考 token）3.75 USD；不是免费额度或实际账单，不包含工具、缓存、税费或第三方加价。2027-01-01 起此记录失效。
text.en: Google Gemini Developer API Standard paid token quote for Gemini 3.8 Flash through 2026-12-31: USD 0.75 input and 3.75 output including thinking per million tokens. Not free-tier access or an actual bill; excludes tools, caching, tax and reseller charges. Expires 2027-01-01.

text.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 的 Google Gemini Developer API Standard 付费 token 报价：请求输入不超过 200k 时，每百万输入/输出（含思考 token）2/12 USD；超过 200k 时为 4/18 USD。不把最低档当通用单价；实际请求长度未知时按费用区间核算，区间跨预算保持未知。不含工具、缓存、税费或第三方加价。
text.en: Google Gemini Developer API Standard paid token quote for Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview: USD 2/12 input/output including thinking per million at <=200k input per request, or 4/18 above 200k. Use a cost range when request lengths are unknown; a range crossing the budget stays unverified. Excludes tools, caching, tax and reseller charges.

text.zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 的 Google Gemini Developer API 原厂付费服务可用于符合条款的专业/商务开发。本记录仅核对 US、SG、JP 服务使用范围；须遵守年龄、用途及其他服务限制，不是全部业务合规结论，不证明数据存储地区或第三方网关许可。
text.en: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview on the direct paid Gemini Developer API supports professional/business development subject to service terms. This record checks US/SG/JP service use only, not all business compliance, data residency or gateway permission.

text.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 的 Google Gemini Developer API 原厂付费服务可用于符合条款的专业/商务开发。本记录仅核对 US、SG、JP 服务使用范围；须遵守年龄、用途及其他服务限制，不是全部业务合规结论，不证明数据存储地区或第三方网关许可。
text.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash on the direct paid Gemini Developer API supports professional/business development subject to service terms. This record checks US/SG/JP service use only, not all business compliance, data residency or gateway permission.

text.zh: OpenAI 官方型号文档记录了 gpt-6.1-sol 的 API 标识和接口能力；这不证明特定网关、账号、国家、数据存放位置或商业使用条件适用。
text.en: OpenAI’s official model documentation establishes the gpt-6.1-sol API identity and documented interfaces; it does not establish access through a particular gateway, account, country, data location or commercial terms.

text.zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 原厂 Standard 非缓存文本 token 观察报价：每百万输入 $2、输出 $10；请求输入超过 272000 token 时整次请求输入 $4、输出 $15。不含缓存、工具费、地域附加费、Fast/Ultrafast、Batch/Flex、税费或任何网关报价；观察后仅 7 天内供限定估算，不是实际账单。
text.en: Observed Standard uncached text-token list prices: USD 2 input / 10 output per million; above 272000 input tokens the full request costs 4 input / 15 output. Excludes cache, tools, regional processing, other tiers, taxes and gateways; seven-day scoped estimate only, not a bill.

text.zh: Codex CLI 官方文档说明可运行本机已安装的开发工具；受所选权限、账户和实际工具环境限制，不扩展为所有 IDE 入口可用，也不证明业务测试通过。
text.en: Codex CLI documents running installed local development tools, subject to permissions, account and environment; other interfaces and measured task outcomes remain unverified.

text.zh: Dify 知识库官方教程说明可导入 PDF、DOCX 等文档并分块索引。中文、扫描件解析准确性仍需用自己的样本验证；支持导入不等于回答准确。
text.en: Dify documents PDF and DOCX knowledge ingestion and indexing; Chinese and scanned-document accuracy require sample validation.

text.zh: Dify 官方文档说明 Chatbot 接入知识库后可启用 Citation and Attribution。必须自行配置检索与模型；有引用开关不保证引用正确或无依据时必然拒答，也不代表所有应用模式都相同。
text.en: Dify documents enabling citation and attribution for a knowledge-connected Chatbot; setup, citation accuracy and abstention require validation, and other app modes are not established.

text.zh: Dify 知识库设置可限定哪些工作区成员访问该知识库。这是工作区成员权限，不证明发布后终端用户的逐文档隔离、SSO 或所有套餐具备同等权限；企业试点仍须做越权检查。
text.en: Dify knowledge settings control workspace-member access, not proven per-document end-user authorization, SSO or identical plan entitlements; test unauthorized access before a company pilot.

text.zh: Dify 官方知识库流程包括文档分块、索引和检索配置，并可连接到应用。它是应用搭建平台，需要配置生成与嵌入服务；不是独立模型，也不是上传文档即可保证可上线的成品问答系统。
text.en: Dify provides configurable chunking, indexing and retrieval for applications; it is an application-building platform requiring model/provider setup, not an independently measured or deployment-ready answer system.

text.zh: Dify Community Edition 官方支持 Docker Compose 自托管，需要部署和维护多项服务及依赖。自托管平台不代表模型或嵌入服务也在本地，不能据此认定完全离线、全部数据不出网或维护成本已知。
text.en: Dify documents Docker Compose self-hosting with multiple services and dependencies; platform self-hosting does not establish local models, offline operation, no egress or known maintenance cost.

text.zh: Dify 通过网页工作区创建知识库和应用；仍需选择 Cloud 或自托管入口并配置模型服务，具体账户、套餐和费用须另外确认。
text.en: Dify offers a web workspace for knowledge bases and applications; choose Cloud or self-hosted access and configure providers, account, plan and cost separately.

text.en: Gemini 4 Argon reached GA on 2026-10-13 with API ID gemini-4-argon, for complex coding, reasoning and multi-step agents.
